ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity (black) pixels forming a 15% perimeter and central bifurcation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips. A central vertical black anchor-shaped marking is located at the median notch. Multiple isolated linear black streaks are distributed across the white field (approx. 4 on left lobe, 2 prominent on right lobe).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an obtuse calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and deep valleys are localized on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges (bottom) transitioning to a slightly convex, heavily serrated sweep along the trailing edges (top) toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes and sparsely along the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions. Prominent long diagonal line on the right lobe extending from the upper-mid section toward the trailing edge. Several smaller vertical and horizontal dark streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the lateral tips and trailing edge. Multiple dark pigmentation marks or rake-like scars visible against the white ventral background.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, faint tan/yellowish circular discoloration or lesion is visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
